description:
S11 E04 — Violence Is What I'm Fixed On
After a mother of three mysteriously vanishes following a night out on the town, investigators uncover a sexual psychopath's nightmarish desires; days later, they discover her body in her own septic tank, revealing how callous the murderer is.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E03 — I Can't Stop Myself
When a 15-year-old Florida girl runs away with her troubled boyfriend, someone brutally murders a 66-year-old disabled man miles away in his home; upon their apprehension, police discover the young couple are, in fact, thrill-seeking murderers.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E05 — I Think I Can Outsmart God
When motorists discover the bodies of a man and woman along I-85, detectives uncover a psychopath with a penchant for guns and violent fantasies.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E06 — I Just Wanted to Hurt Her
When a young woman vanishes, it doesn't take long for detectives to zero in on her estranged husband; when questioned, he appears eerily calm, but what they soon reveal is an impulsive and rage-driven psychopath who cannot tolerate rejection.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E02 — I Don't Belong Out Here
When a disturbed brother slaughters three generations of a family, he quickly confesses and continues by confessing to a ten-year-old cold case.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E01 — I Guess I'm a Maniac
Detectives find a woman partially clothed and strangled to death in a wooded ditch in Florida; with no leads or suspects, her case goes cold; a surprise confession almost ten years later exposes a deviant sexual psychopath with a murderous fantasy.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E08 — I Wanted To Keep Her
When a grandmother vanishes, her grandson spins a twisted narrative about her demise and the disturbing location of her body inside a freezer; it doesn't take long for detectives to uncover the killer responsible, a parasitic psychopath.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E11 — Something Took Control of Me
When a psychopathic husband kills his young wife and leaves her decapitated head in a bathtub, detectives question him about the crime; they realize they are confronting a malingering psychopath with control issues.

title: American Monster
description:
S13 E10 — Double Take
A CEO at just 29, Jenea Harvison supports her husband as his dreams of becoming a football player falter; living in his wife's shadow soon proves too much for Roy Harvison, and the price will be more than one life.

title: American Monster
description:
S13 E05 — Momma's Boy
An Ohio woman is incapable of throwing out her dangerous son, no matter how many times he threatens to kill her, and her devotion is the root of her demise.

title: American Monster
description:
S13 E09 — Draw a Picture
Elena falls head over heels for Brandon, but his domineering behavior quickly escalates, creating tension and conflict in their relationship.

title: American Monster
description:
S13 E04 — Mom Is Always Right
A small-town marriage ends in tragedy when a man who uses a wheelchair discovers his loving wife of 10 years wants to end their marriage; a jury must determine if he acted in self-defense or murder.

title: American Monster
description:
S13 E01 — Control Freak
Tricia and Galen Westfall appear to be the perfect couple; however, the reality is that Galen is jealous and controlling. When investigators find two bodies in a car crash, they uncover the grisly truth about a deadly relationship.

title: American Monster
description:

Nurse and private investigator Nikki and Jimmy Cappello are a dynamic duo, until Jimmy suddenly goes missing.

description:

description: Four people die in a Christmas Eve massacre at a Florida furniture store, leaving owner Tommy Zeigler as the sole survivor. Fifty years later, lingering doubts about the case fuel a new investigation using modern technology to search for answers.

title: The Christmas Tree Murder
description: A man forms a crush on his co-worker at a retail store selling seasonal decor; his inappropriate behavior gets him fired, turning his infatuation into a dangerous obsession; he follows her when her job sends her out of state.

title: Murder by Numbers
description:
S01 E04 — Murder Calling
Firefighters find the bullet-ridden bodies of Robert and Dorothy Pape while responding to a call about smoke billowing from a garage, in which they find a truck on fire; later, police realize the smoldering truck does not belong to the homeowners.

title: Murder by Numbers
description:
S01 E06 — Run From the Devil
In Amherst, N.Y., a missing college student's body is found hidden in the woods near a bike path, making the townspeople realize that the predator who has been stalking women for years has escalated from rapist to killer.

title: 48 Hours on ID
description:
S20 E28 — Death by Eyedrops
Jessy Kurczewski calls police to report that she found Lynn Hernan dead in her recliner; the toxicology report shows a toxic ingredient in Lynn's blood and the authorities take a closer look at Jessy.

title: Ken and Barbie Killers: The Lost Murder Tapes
description:
S01 E01 — The Murders
Paul Bernardo and Karla Homolka embark on a passionate love affair; then, missing schoolgirls Leslie Mahaffy and Kristen French turn up dead, and a battered and bruised Homolka tells police Bernardo is the murderer.

title: Ken and Barbie Killers: The Lost Murder Tapes
description:
S01 E02 — The Tapes
Karla Homolka tells the police that her husband, Bernardo, recorded videos of his assaults on schoolgirls Leslie Mahaffy and Kristen French; police are unable to find the tapes despite an exhaustive search.

title: Ken and Barbie Killers: The Lost Murder Tapes
description:
S01 E03 — The Deal
Paul Bernardo's lawyers find the videotapes of the assaults on Leslie Mahaffy and Kristen French; the tapes reveal Homolka is complicit in the crimes; unaware of this new information, prosecutors make a controversial deal with Homolka.

title: Ken and Barbie Killers: The Lost Murder Tapes
description:
S01 E04 — The Trial
Paul Bernardo is convicted of the murders of Leslie Mahaffy and Kristen French and sentenced to life in prison; Homolka is released after serving just 12 years for her part in the crimes; today, she walks around as a free citizen.

title: The Green River Killer: Mind of a Monster
description: Victims of "The Green River Killer" are still being found; with access to hundreds of hours of unseen police footage, the shocking truth behind one of America's most prolific serial killers is revealed.

title: The Co-Ed Killer: Mind of a Monster
description:
S01 E01 — Part 1
Ed Kemper appears to be a gentle giant who offers rides to young female hitchhikers, but behind his charming smile lurks a perverted monster; recorded audio confessions reveal the dark fantasies behind one of America's most notorious serial killers.

title: The Co-Ed Killer: Mind of a Monster
description:
S01 E02 — Part 2
After killing his grandparents, 15-year-old Ed Kemper is sent away to a mental institution, where he uses his near-genius IQ to deceive psychiatrists.

title: The Co-Ed Killer: Mind of a Monster
description:
S01 E03 — Part 3
Fearing arrest, Kemper decides he must finally deal with his mother, bringing this story to a devastating finale; in custody, a psychiatrist gives Kemper a truth serum, which reveals his most horrifying secrets on tape.

title: Unmasking a Monster: Aileen Wuornos
description:
S01 E01 — Face to Face With the Monster
In 1990, someone is stalking men on Florida's highways; clues lead detectives to a realization: the serial killer is a woman; in a risky operation, an undercover officer tracks her down to a bar.

title: Unmasking a Monster: Aileen Wuornos
description:
S01 E02 — I'm a Good Girl
Working with her ex-girlfriend, detectives set a secret trap for Wuornos.

title: Unmasking a Monster: Aileen Wuornos
description:
S01 E03 — The World Will Learn
Wuornos risks her life by telling the jury her story, in her own words.

title: A Body in the Snow: The Trial of Karen Read
description:
S01 E01 — What Happened at 34 Fairview?
When Boston police officer John O'Keefe turns up dead in the snow, authorities arrest his girlfriend Karen Read for murder; a bombshell Google search and an anonymous tip point to an alleged conspiracy in Canton.

title: A Body in the Snow: The Trial of Karen Read
description:
S01 E02 — Did I Hit Him?
The murder trial of Karen Read begins and jurors hear testimony from witnesses at the scene where they found John O'Keefe's body; outside the courthouse, Turtleboy advocates for Karen's innocence.

title: A Body in the Snow: The Trial of Karen Read
description:
S01 E03 — How Long to Die in Cold
As the trial continues, more details emerge about allegedly sloppy evidence collection, conflicting testimonies, manipulated video footage and baffling DNA results; Karen's team suggests a conspiracy and cover-up are at play.

title: A Body in the Snow: The Trial of Karen Read
description:
S01 E04 — A Town Divided
The jury hears testimony about Karen's alleged affair, scandalous texts, mysterious butt dials and conflicting Google search timestamps; the conflict in Canton grows.

title: A Body in the Snow: The Trial of Karen Read
description:
S01 E05 — The Verdict
As the trial winds down, experts attempt to recreate John's death, the defense brings in one final witness and closing arguments grip the nation; Karen, emotional after a long haul, anxiously awaits her fate; the jury returns with an unexpected note.

Police struggle to solve the heartbreaking murder of a talented young woman, but it will take years to realize that the clue to unlock the mystery is hidden within the crime scene evidence.

description:

When police find the lifeless body of a young mother, her husband becomes the prime suspect; when an in-depth investigation against him stalls, it raised a critical question, had police been focused on the wrong man all along?

title: On the Case With Paula Zahn

A killer guns down a man during a home invasion; the evidence points to a well-planned crime; can police find who's behind the attack?

title: On the Case With Paula Zahn

Police retrace the steps of a young woman's preparations for a romantic Valentine's dinner that ended in her murder; hidden in the crime scene is the clue that unlocks the mystery.

Ruby Franke gains fame for her strict parenting style, but her partnership with counselor Jodi Hildebrandt spirals into control; when Ruby's child escapes, he exposes abuse and the damaging, cult-like beliefs at the heart of their bond.

Survivors break their silence as Jessi exposes Hildebrandt's cult-like control; Ruby's journals confirm the emotional and physical abuse of her children; with evidence mounting, the court holds the women accountable and delivers long-awaited justice.

title: Ruby & Jodi: A Cult of Sin and Influence

Ruby's words expose abuse at the hands of Jodi Hildebrandt, but is it over?

Desiray is lost and vulnerable when she meets Ray; he seems kind and understanding; Ray lures her into his trap, revealing his violence and cruelty; Desiray finds herself trapped in a living hell and must fight like hell to survive.

description:

Kayla's mother pays a hefty price when she breaks free of her husband Richard; he plots a final and brutal revenge.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:

When Sara learns of her mother's murder, she slowly begins to realize who her father truly is, unearthing her family's dirty secrets along the way.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S16 E05 — My Wicked Stepmother
After her father, Donald Hoop, meets a woman named Joy, Desiree's life spirals; Joy is hot-tempered, cruel and controlling; Desiree knows her dad can't escape his toxic marriage, but she has no clue that Joy is orchestrating a cold-blooded murder.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S10 E02 — He Got Into My Soul
Christian Fuhr receives a life sentence, and his girlfriend, Ammie Turos, believes he is innocent; when she discovers he's guilty, her conviction is replaced by uncertainty, and she wonders if her life had been in danger the entire time.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S15 E09 — He Asked Me to Be His Hitman
When Roger's best friend, Bob Duke, asks for a favor, he thinks Bob is venting; when he asks again, Roger worries about Bob's wife and son; after an accident occurs, Roger knows his friend is a killer.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S18 E05 — The Blood on My Brother's Hands
Patrick Bruce idolizes his fun-loving older brother, Lance; however, as he watches Lance descend into darkness, he feels powerless to stop him; he never imagines the horror of the unspeakable acts his brother is capable of - until it's too late.

title: Evil Lives Here: My Child the Killer
description:
S01 E03 — I'm the Monster's Mother
Jeannette does everything she can to care for her son, Timmy; everything is going well until his dark side emerges, and he becomes violent and dangerous; despite every effort to help her son, she watches helplessly as he spirals into darkness.

title: I Want to Kill My Boss
description:
S01 E01 — Top Gunned
Marana Aerospace Solutions in Arizona is as hot and wild as the surrounding desert. When someone guns down one of the bosses, suspicion falls on the employees. Who hated the boss enough to kill him?

title: Vengeance: Killer Coworkers
description:
S01 E09 — Body in the Bathtub
Fresno mattress factory manager James Blanco worked to provide the American Dream for his employees, but when he's gunned down in the shower, investigators must find out if he was betrayed by a disgruntled coworker.
